capabilities: Encrypt selected text or pasted tokens with AES-256-GCM
Render secrets as masked pills with timed reveal
Scan vault for plaintext credentials and batch-encrypt
Copy secrets to a self-wiping clipboard
Encrypt whole notes and export to KeePass XML or CSV
disambiguation: Not a password manager or vault sync tool; it encrypts and masks secrets already stored inside Obsidian notes.
extras: README states no external network requests; key derived with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 at 600,000 iterations and CryptoKey stored non-extractable. Includes an offline single-file HTML decryptor for recovery without Obsidian. Clipboard-manager exclusion flags are macOS/Windows only.
problem: Secrets pasted into notes sit in plaintext Markdown, so they leak through sync, Git history, screen sharing, clipboard managers, and other plugins.
summary: Local encryption plugin that masks API keys and passwords in notes as clickable pills and scans the vault for plaintext secrets.
